_why: Runtimes that installed SUNMI tills report but that the normal `eas update`
every merge to each entry here.
app.json uses runtimeVersion.policy 'appVersion' with version '1.0.0', so the
normal publish already targets '1.0.0' — the runtime the installed APK reports.
The list is therefore empty and must stay empty while those two agree.
THE MOMENT expo.version CHANGES, add the PREVIOUS version here: under the
appVersion policy a bump mints a new runtime, and every till still running the
old APK stops receiving updates. CI's native-runtime-guard job enforces this.
